store/b2b-onboarding.apply.title: Apply for a business account
store/b2b-onboarding.apply.demo-notice: Demo store: upload sample documents only, never real company or personal documents.
store/b2b-onboarding.section.contact-hel: This person becomes the administrator of your business account and receives the approval email.
store/b2b-onboarding.section.documents-h: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each.
store/b2b-onboarding.error.too-many: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
store/b2b-onboarding.error.failed: We couldn't submit your application. Please try again.
store/b2b-onboarding.error.request-too-l: The upload is too large. Each document can be up to 5 MB.
store/b2b-onboarding.success.title: Application received
store/b2b-onboarding.success.text: Keep your reference and status code. You need both to check your application. We show the code only once.
store/b2b-onboarding.status.title: Application status
store/b2b-onboarding.status.intro: Enter the reference and status code you received when you applied.
store/b2b-onboarding.status.not-found: No application matches this reference and status code.
store/b2b-onboarding.status.approved: Approved. Check your email to sign in to your business account.
store/b2b-onboarding.apply.intro-steps: A few short steps. Our team reviews every application and emails your administrator when the account is ready.
store/b2b-onboarding.steps.label: Application steps
store/b2b-onboarding.company.title: Tell us about your company
store/b2b-onboarding.company.help: Use the legal name and registration number shown on your registration certificate.
store/b2b-onboarding.administrator.title: Who will manage the account?
store/b2b-onboarding.address.title: Where is your business based?
store/b2b-onboarding.address.help: This becomes the default address of your organization.
store/b2b-onboarding.documents.title: Upload your documents
store/b2b-onboarding.review.title: Check your application
store/b2b-onboarding.review.help: Make sure everything is right before you submit. You can edit any section.
store/b2b-onboarding.upload.hint: PDF, JPG or PNG · max 5 MB
store/b2b-onboarding.next.title: What happens next
store/b2b-onboarding.next.approval-text: Your administrator gets a sign-in email.
store/b2b-onboarding.summary.title: Your application so far
store/b2b-onboarding.summary.empty: Your answers appear here as you go.
store/b2b-onboarding.india.title: Indian business identifiers
store/b2b-onboarding.india.help: Applications from India need the business's PAN. We verify each identifier automatically.
store/b2b-onboarding.india.demo-notice: Demo store: use made-up numbers in the right format, never a real PAN or real bank details.
store/b2b-onboarding.bank.title: Which bank account should we verify?
store/b2b-onboarding.bank.help: We send a small test transfer to check that the account exists and is in your business's name.
store/b2b-onboarding.address.country-on-: Country: {country}. It was chosen on the Company step.
store/b2b-onboarding.hint.india.pan: 10 characters, such as ABCCD1234X. The 4th letter shows the holder type: C for a company, F for a firm.
store/b2b-onboarding.hint.india.iec: 10 letters or digits, from the DGFT certificate
store/b2b-onboarding.hint.india.ifsc: 11 characters, such as SBIN0001234, from a cheque or the bank
store/b2b-onboarding.hint.india.accountH: As the bank shows it. It should be your business's legal name.
store/b2b-onboarding.error.unsupported-t: Use a PDF, JPG or PNG file
store/b2b-onboarding.error.pan-not-busin: This is an individual's PAN. Use the business's own PAN, whose 4th letter is C, F, H, A, T, B, L, J or G

admin/b2b-onboarding.navigation.label: Applications
admin/b2b-onboarding.queue.title: Business applications
admin/b2b-onboarding.queue.subtitle: Review new B2B customers stage by stage. Approval creates their organization.
admin/b2b-onboarding.load-error: Couldn't load applications. Reload the page to try again.
admin/b2b-onboarding.field.name: Name
admin/b2b-onboarding.document.only-on-re: Documents are accepted or rejected on review stages.
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.hint-review: Accept every document to pass this step.
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.hint-verific: The eligibility check must pass before this step can pass.
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.hint-approva: Approving creates the organization, its cost center and the administrator user in B2B Organizations, and sends the approval email.
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.note: Internal note (optional, never shown to the applicant)
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.reason: Reason for the applicant (10 to 500 characters)
admin/b2b-onboarding.india.title: Indian business identifiers
admin/b2b-onboarding.india.reveal-notice: PAN and account numbers are masked. Opening one in full is recorded in the history.
admin/b2b-onboarding.kyc.title: Identifier checks
admin/b2b-onboarding.kyc.not-checked: PAN, IEC, Udyam and bank account are checked together with the eligibility check.
admin/b2b-onboarding.kyc.decision-note: Why? For example, which document confirms it (10 to 1000 characters, internal)
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.hint-needs-d: Accept or reject each identifier check that needs a review before this step can pass.
admin/b2b-onboarding.action.hint-blocked: A check failed or was rejected, so this step can only be rejected.
admin/b2b-onboarding.kyc.demo-notice: Demo: identifier checks use a simulated KYC provider. Numbers ending in 0 fail, ending in 5 need review, and all others are verified. A bank account ending in 7 returns a slightly different name.
admin/b2b-onboarding.demo-notice: Demo: the eligibility check uses a simulated company registry. Registration numbers ending in 0 are not found, ending in 9 are dissolved, and all others pass.
